## 03 - EGX Daily Market Update

Fetches the most recent trading sessions (a short lookback window, not the full history) per active stock, upserts into `daily_prices`, and reports whether TODAY actually has data — EGX does not trade every weekday (holidays), so this workflow never assumes a session happened; it verifies.

Optionally fetches EGX30 index candles into `index_prices` for market-regime use.

Called by 12-egx-daily-master-workflow after 01; can also be run manually.

### ⚠️ CONFIGURE BEFORE USE

Same endpoint-configuration note as workflow 02 — edit the HTTP Request node URLs to match your provider's documented endpoints. The index fetch is OPTIONAL and tolerant of failure (continues without EGX30 data).

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO daily_prices (stock_id, trading_date, open, high, low, close, volume, traded_value)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8)
ON CONFLICT (stock_id, trading_date) DO UPDATE SET
  open = EXCLUDED.open, high = EXCLUDED.high, low = EXCLUDED.low, close = EXCLUDED.close,
  volume = EXCLUDED.volume, traded_value = EXCLUDED.traded_value, updated_at = now();

INSERT INTO workflow_errors (workflow_name, symbol, trading_date, error_message, payload)
VALUES ('03-egx-daily-market-update', $1, $2, $3, $4::jsonb);

INSERT INTO index_prices (index_code, trading_date, open, high, low, close, volume)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)
ON CONFLICT (index_code, trading_date) DO UPDATE SET
  open = EXCLUDED.open, high = EXCLUDED.high, low = EXCLUDED.low, close = EXCLUDED.close, volume = EXCLUDED.volume;

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stocks WHERE exchange = $1 AND active = TRUE)::int AS active_stock_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM daily_prices dp JOIN stocks s ON s.id = dp.stock_id
     WHERE s.exchange = $1 AND s.active = TRUE
       AND dp.trading_date = COALESCE($2::date, CURRENT_DATE))::int AS today_price_count,
  COALESCE($2::date, CURRENT_DATE)::text AS effective_date;
